extraction.Name: Mary Blacksmith, formerly Mary Prue
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded May 8, 1920, by Jordan State Bank
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Mortgaged and sold; Mary and her husband mortgaged the land to Olaf Nelson for $1500 on June 4, 1920; again on September 1, 1920, to John R. Martin for $450. Then on February 8, 1921, Mary and her husband, Gilbert Blacksmith conveyed the land by deed to Joseph Prue for $1.00 and other valuable consideration.
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Olaf Nelson for $1500; mortgaged to John R. Martin for $450; conveyed to Joseph Prue for $1.00 and other valuable consideration
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739692 issued; Southeast quarter section 13, township 98, range 79; receipt for patent was signed by the allottee April 3, 1920; husband is Gilbert Blacksmith; land conveyed to Joseph Prue
